notes: v6.4.1 - Song Finder finishes the job by itself: after it names the song in your video, it downloads the track from YouTube and imports it into your project automatically - no manual steps. New Preview buttons let you hear a song before you choose it. The Emoji & Sounds tab is now split into three tidy sections (Blue Emoji / SFX Sounds / Song Finder) so nothing hides at the bottom of a long scroll. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
